d: The Celtics defeated the Nets, 125-124 tonight in Boston. Jayson Tatum contributed a team-high 40 points to go with 8 assists 5 rebounds and 2 three pointers, with Paul George of the Celtics adding an additional 20 points (8-16 FG, 1-6 3P), 7 rebounds, and 7 assists in the game. Michael Porter Jr. finished with a team-high 27 points along with 12 rebounds for the Nets in the losing effort. The Celtics improve their record to 3-1 with the win, while the Nets fall to 0-4 for the season.
